title: 군인 급식 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Rations and Standard Amount for Rations)
(1) Military personnel shall be provided each day with staple food and side dishes (hereinafter referred to as "rations in kind"): Provided, That the Chief of Staff of the Army, Navy or Air Force may pay a fixed amount in cash (hereinafter referred to as the "standard amount for rations") in lieu of rations in kind to military personnel whom that Chief of Staff has ordered to reside outside military installations.
(2) The standard amount for rations shall be the amount determined each year in the budget of expenditures on the basis of the cost necessary to provide rations in kind to one member of the military personnel for one day.
(3) Military personnel referred to in the proviso to paragraph (1) shall be paid, in the following month, an amount calculated by multiplying the standard amount for rations by the number of days in the relevant month on which they did not receive rations in kind.
